# jobrunner

Small job runner with a pluggable retry policy.

## Retry policy

`run_job` makes an initial call and retries only `RetryError::Transient`
failures. `RetryError::Permanent` failures are returned immediately. Configure
the total number of calls with `max_attempts` (including the first call), the
initial retry delay with `base_delay_ms`, and the upper bound with
`max_delay_ms`. Delays grow exponentially (`base_delay_ms`, then double each
time) and saturate at `max_delay_ms`.

A `Sleeper` is injected so applications can provide real sleeping and tests can
record delays without waiting.
